subject: Engineering Fundamentals
title: Building Information Modeling: The Blueprint Revolution
description: A quick win: understand Building Information Modeling: The Blueprint Revolution.

hook.text: BIM is not just a 3D model. It's a database where every wall, pipe, and beam carries data about cost, material, and schedule.

buildup.text: Traditional blueprints show geometry. BIM models contain data. Change a wall thickness and the cost estimate updates instantly.

discovery.text: Clash detection finds conflicts before construction. If a duct runs through a beam, BIM catches it on screen instead of on site.

twist.text: Many countries mandate BIM for public projects. The UK required it since 2016. Small firms resist because they can't afford it.

climax.text: BIM extends into facility management. After construction, the model becomes a maintenance database for the building's entire life.

punchline.text: Not a drawing. A database. Every component tracked from design to demolition.

quiz.question: What does clash detection in BIM prevent?
options: Budget overruns caused by unexpected material price increases during construction
Physical conflicts like ducts running through beams, caught on screen instead of on site
Scheduling conflicts between different construction crews on the same floor
